source.mainFunction:

[비타민C]①결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요②철의 흡수에 필요③유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
[비타민E]①유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요

Health Functional FoodManganese 0.65mgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B2 0.8mgVitamin C 64mgVitamin E 4mgZinc 3.8mgFolate 80μgPantothenic acid 2.2mgOnce a day

FBL멀티비타민앤미네랄Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)유유헬스케어 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 0.65mg of Manganese, 700μg of Vitamin A, 0.8mg of Vitamin B2, 64mg of Vitamin C, 4mg of Vitamin E, 3.8mg of Zinc, 80μg of Folate, 2.2mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 0.65mg Manganese, 700μg Vitamin A, 0.8mg Vitamin B2, 64mg Vitamin C, 4mg Vitamin E, 3.8mg Zinc, 80μg Folate, 2.2mg Pantothenic acid
  • Made by (주)유유헬스케어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 tablets per servingLet it dissolve

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (0.65mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.8mg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (64mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (4mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (3.8mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (80μg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (2.2mg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 미황색의 원형 정제
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage ① 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 병포장의 경우 제품 개봉 후 보관시 흡습방지를 위해 뚜껑을 꼭 닫아야 함.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
